scope: Observed native TPS DVHs from the public synthetic 1-mm-margin benchmark plan; includes transfer and evaluator effects, not an isolated HDSS benefit.

protocol.source: Native TPS DVH exports, not our independent dose calculation
protocol.plotting: Every supplied point joined in its original order. Repeated RayStation dose coordinates retained. No forced stairs, fitted shifts, renormalisation or smoothing.
protocol.metric_note: D98/D50/V20 here are approximate readouts from exported points, not unrounded directly queried native metrics.
